name: Passwords4Free
description: Passwords4Free is a free, privacy-first website for generating strong random passwords and checking password strength. Everything runs in your browser using the Web Crypto API — nothing you type is ever sent to a server, logged, or stored. The site also publishes friendly, practical password and online-safety guides.
featureList: Cryptographically secure password generation via Web Crypto API
Password strength analyser with time-to-crack estimates and entropy calculation
Customisable password options: length, character types, exclude look-alikes
100% client-side — no data transmission, no accounts, no tracking
Password and online-safety blog by Leo Martin

audience.description: Anyone who needs strong, secure passwords and wants plain-English guidance on online safety — from casual users to security-conscious individuals.
